observations: Photos show multiple stacks of wooden pallets/crates arranged in a warehouse room.
Many pallet boards have circular stamp marks reading “EPAL”.
Some pallets look visibly used (darkened wood, scuffs), but overall appear intact.
No clear pallet count, dimensions, or whether they are heat-treated/treated is shown beyond the EPAL stamp.
No scale/weight certificate is visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: The photos show wooden pallets stacked and arranged like a stacking base.

claims.claim: It available for pickup only in Port Harcourt
claims.evidence: No location details are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Photos show pallets that look dry/clean enough, but dryness/“no water added” cannot be confirmed remotely.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No certified scale reading, receipt, or weight ticket is shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Total quantity/weight may not be 500 kg (seller could be estimating; pallets vary in weight).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the pallets on a certified scale with the scale display visible, plus a weight ticket/receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a smaller/unknown quantity (worst case: not guaranteed to be 500 kg).

risks.risk: Condition may be worse than it looks (broken boards, missing stringers, or pallets not fit for use).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the worst damaged pallets (corners, stringers, deck boards) and a quick video walk-through showing all sides.
risks.if_unproven: Price as mixed/used pallets with possible repairs needed.

risks.risk: EPAL authenticity/grade may be overstated (stamp present but could be non-EPAL or mixed grades).
risks.proof: Photos of multiple stamps plus any markings/labels on the pallets (including any maker/ID markings) and confirmation of pallet type/grade.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used wooden pallets (not premium EPAL grade).

risks.risk: Moisture/contamination risk (even if it looks dry, it could be damp or have odor/infestation).
risks.proof: Moisture meter reading (if available) or photos showing storage conditions; also ask about any pest treatment/inspection.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially not fully dry/clean for sensitive uses.

proof_requests: Photo/video of the certified scale reading showing the pallets’ total weight (with the display readable) and ideally a weight ticket.
Pallet count or a clear method to verify quantity (e.g., number of pallets per stack and number of stacks).
Close-ups of the most damaged pallets (corners and underside) and a short video showing the full set.
Photos of pallet markings beyond the EPAL stamp (any ID/maker/grade markings) to confirm grade/authenticity.
response.reason: The photos confirm wooden pallets with EPAL stamps, but the key pricing drivers—total weight/quantity (claimed 500 kg) and condition/grade—are not verifiable remotely from the images. Request the certified scale proof and condition/quantity verification before pricing.
